purpose: How far a character LoRA holds. One woman, one room, one light, one standing pose: the ONLY thing that changes between cells is how much of the frame she occupies, so the distance at which identity stops binding is measured rather than felt. The legend carries the two models that can load a character LoRA at all (Krea 2 Turbo and BigLust v1.6), so the same ladder reads on both. Prompts name no character - the trigger token and the LoRA supply the identity - so this catalog is reusable for the next character trained. The three-far cell deliberately changes a second variable: it reproduces the reported case where three people at a distance come back only SIMILAR, and it exists as that reproduction, not as a ladder step. Expected result, so it is not mistaken for a bug: identity is strong in the close cells and weakens as the figure shrinks, because a LoRA's grip scales with the pixels on the face - and on a model that declares no reference conditioning there is no second identity channel to recover it with. Two things vary the outcome and are worth running: canvas size (a far frame at 1536x1536 gives the face roughly twice the pixels of the same frame at 1024) and LoRA strength (the picker offers 0.6 to 1.0; 0.8 was the strength used in the 2026-10-03 runs). Only the declared SEED is applied by the render driver - steps, cfg, sampler and size come from the selected model's own qualified envelope, not from these files.
